meta.name: performance-analyzer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze influencer campaign performance", "compare influencers", or "find what content worked"; produces metric scorecards vs target and benchmark, platform/influencer/content rankings, engagement-quality and sentiment reads, conversion-attribution breakdowns, and ranked learnings. Not for dollar-level return math — use roi-calculator.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析达人营销活动表现，生成指标评分卡与排名洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估达人合作效果并优化投放策略
copy.tagline_en: Analyze influencer campaign performance with metric scorecards and rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate influencer partnerships and optimize campaign strategy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析网红活动效果：对比目标与基准，给出核心指标评分卡；按平台、创作者、内容排名；评估互动质量和评论情感；归因转化；并输出排名后的经验总结。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析网红活动效果、比较创作者或找出哪些内容有效时触发。通常在活动中期或结束后使用。

say.text: 分析夏季护肤活动的效果。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含评分卡、排名和洞察的完整分析。

say.text: 比较 @creatorA 和 @creatorB 在本次活动的表现。
say.note: Claude 会对比两位创作者的指标并给出排名。

say.text: 找出这次活动中效果最好的内容类型。
say.note: Claude 会分析内容表现并总结获胜模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes influencer campaign performance: scores core metrics against targets and benchmarks, ranks platforms/influencers/content, reads engagement quality and sentiment, attributes conversions, and outputs ranked learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze influencer campaign performance, compare influencers, or find what content worked. Typically used mid-flight or post-campaign.

say_en.text: Analyze performance of our summer skincare campaign.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full analysis with scorecards, rankings, and insights.
Claude compares metrics and ranks the two creators.

say_en.text: Find the best-performing content type in this campaign.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes content performance and names winning patterns.
